info_blocks:
The following are optional supplementary details for the organisers. Please fill them in. They help us prepare the event infrastructure better, or to reach out for help.

Regarding pets: the event is primarily designed for you. We trust you can arrange care for your pets while you're away. If that's not possible for some reason, you can bring them along.

Food

The pub U Zeleného Draka will be operating at the event. We just need an informative choice — are you planning to handle meals yourselves, or rely on the pub's offer? This helps us prepare, it doesn't commit you to anything.

agreements.rules: I confirm that I have read the event rules and acknowledge them.
agreements.a_fire: I acknowledge that digging fire pits is prohibited. All fireplace sites will be approved by the organizers and only approved fire pits will receive the corresponding marking. No fires may be lit outside approved fire pits. You can prepare a fire pit by gathering stones and removing turf. Before leaving, you will return ALL stones to where you took them and cover the area back with the removed turf.
agreements.a_cars: I acknowledge that cars will be parked in the usual parking area. Access to the camping meadow is permitted only along the marked road. No car parks on the campsite. After unloading your equipment, please re-park as soon as possible.
agreements.system: I agree to the processing of my personal data under the General Data Protection Regulation.

info_html:
Hello, welcome to the registration form for the Lord of the Rings [2026] LARP!
If you need to arrange or discuss anything, write to us at: info@panprstenu.cz

How the registration works:
1) You fill in this form
2) You'll receive an email confirming your registration, including the payment details.
3) Once paid, we'll record your payment in the system. It is not automatic — give us a day or two.
4) Confirmation of your payment will arrive in another automatic email.
If you have any questions, or if nothing happens for a long time, write to us at: info@panprstenu.cz
